title: My very first game just went live and I'd really like to know if it's actually fun
author: Ok_Leadership_429
selftext:
This is my very first game, created entirely on my own. It uses a one-touch control scheme: you orbit a ring and tap to dash toward the next one; each round lasts about 30 seconds.

Since I built everything myself, I lack an outside perspective; I can't tell if the game is actually fun or if I've simply spent too much time on it to judge it objectively. If you give it a try, please feel free to leave a comment about what you liked or what didn't seem quite right—even just a few lines would be a huge help. Also, what about the difficulty? Is it too easy or too hard? 🤔 

Free, no forced ads, and playable offline.
